results.title: ‘None of this is normal’
results.description: PUERTO MORELOS, Mexico (AP): Swaths of seaweed are blanketing the beaches and coastlines of the Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico, suffocating shorelines and snuffing out marine life while spooking visitors in areas that depend heavily on tourism. Some 27 million metric tons of self-sustaining sargassum have been recorded in the Atlantic, Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico in July, according to a report released Friday by the University of South Florida’s Optical Oceanography Lab. The prickly seaweed covers miles of coastline, releasing a foul smell as it rots onshore.

results.title: MWF seeks RM1 million annual funding after five golds in Glasgow
results.description: SEPANG: The Malaysian Weightlifting Federation (MWF) has described its haul of five gold medals at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow as a "clear signal" for the country's sports authorities to consider allocating at least RM1 million annually to further develop the sport.
